{{Top|leg}}
The '''Celahdrine X-Taxi''' was a type of [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] that was used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]],<ref name="BotB">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast}}</ref> and in the [[platform city]] [[Soboll]], on the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].<ref name="LoS">{{LivingForce|Inside-out: Lockdown on Soboll}}</ref> During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]] traveled to Caarimon, and they were lent a Celahdrine X-Taxi to use while they were on the world.<ref name="BotB" />
